pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with moderately smooth pixel gradients at edges. Patches exhibit internal color gradients from darker brown centers to lighter peripheral tones. Spatial distribution shows larger relative area on the mid-flank, decreasing in size toward the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways separating the patch regions. Junction nodes frequently intersect 3 or 4 patch corners. Pixel thickness is variable but remains consistent enough to form an unbroken topological graph across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency textured silhouette extending from the upper neck to the shoulder ridge, representing the mane. The contour is distinctly non-smooth against the background.
